tools.name: ask_podmule
tools.description: Ask PodMule for a concise read-only domain answer or an advisory route plan. Use this for quick questions, summaries, diagnostics, drafting, "what should I do?" prompts, and ambiguous action requests. This tool never performs writes. For exact capability contracts use search; for one selected action

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search available PodMule capabilities for this OAuth token. Use this when you need the exact capability name or schema before calling execute. For ambiguous domain requests, call ask_podmule first.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Execute one OAuth-visible PodMule capability. Reads run directly. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ask_podmule" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
